protocol.input: initial environment state and task goal
protocol.policy_output: one action identifier from the declared finite action domain
protocol.transition: local deterministic or seeded stochastic environment step
protocol.latency: complete episode wall time including every policy and transition step

datasets.state: player position, box positions, walls, and targets
datasets.reason: fixed four-way actions and genuine state-changing pushes

datasets.observation: updated tile board and solved flag
datasets.reason: finite directional moves with exact successor state

datasets.state: binary light grid and remaining move budget
datasets.reason: each finite cell action deterministically changes a local state

datasets.observation: updated vehicle layout or blocked-action feedback
datasets.reason: finite parameterized actions and state-dependent legality

datasets.state: grid, agent position, holes, and goal
datasets.reason: fixed actions with explicit feedback and optional seeded stochasticity

datasets.state: ordered disk stacks on three towers
datasets.reason: source and target towers are finite and legality is state-dependent

excluded.wordle: candidate words would require an externally defined dictionary; not a fixed action domain in the current protocol
excluded.textarena_social_games: multi-agent and hidden-opponent dynamics would confound the single-policy latency study
excluded.current_bfcl_and_api_bank: direct tool-call formatting without a state transition
